description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance payable to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payable to workers in specific trades (cocoa, cardamom, and pepper) based on the Cost of Living Index Number. This falls under public sector service administration regarding worker compensation and benefits, specifically addressing wage adjustments for certain categories of workers, which aligns with Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) that cover "Service conditions and benefits" and "Public sector salary revisions."
